links.comparator_used: Vanilla, chain-of-thought and reflection-of-thoughts prompting without retrieval (model's internal knowledge), across GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro and Claude Opus 4
links.outcome: Accuracy on MSI cancer benchmark questions (especially complex decision-making tasks), safety (fabrication vs refusal) and error composition
links.effect: RAG was the most effective intervention and significantly improved accuracy in complex decision-making tasks; it shifted safety from high-risk fabrications to safer refusals. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Introduced false refusals (safety-utility trade-off); the main bottleneck moved from knowledge deficits to retrieval failures, making retrieval precision and knowledge base quality critical.
links.quote: The integration of RAG proved to be the most effective intervention.
